# Audio Viewer

> A fast, single-file audio player. Drop an .mp3/.wav/.flac/.m4a/.ogg/.opus file to play it with ID3 tags, cover art and a waveform — all in your browser, nothing uploaded.

The viewer is one self-contained HTML file (no build step) and works offline. Files never leave the visitor's device — no uploads, no accounts, no server-side processing.
